paper.title_en: Black Hole Shadows and Quasinormal Modes with Dark Matter at the Horizon
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we study the effect of a surrounding dark matter halo on two horizon-scale observables of a black hole: its shadow and quasinormal-mode spectrum. We consider a Schwarzschild black hole embedded in a Hernquist halo and construct a one-parameter family of solutions that preserve the total halo mass while varying how the halo density vanishes at the horizon. By closing the Einstein equations with an Einstein-cluster stress tensor, we show that horizon regularity requires the density to vanish at least linearly. Our results also indicate that the dominant energy condition is violated in a thin layer outside the horizon, highlighting the limitations of the Einstein-cluster description within the photon sphere. We demonstrate that, at fixed black hole mass, the halo always enlarges the shadow, with the effect becoming more pronounced for more massive and compact halos. Comparison with Event Horizon Telescope observations of Sgr\,A$^*$ and M87$^*$ shows that only sufficiently compact halos can be constrained, with the inferred bounds depending sensitively on whether the observed mass is identified with the black hole mass or the total mass of the system. We further show that the halo lowers both the oscillation frequencies and damping rates of electromagnetic and axial gravitational quasinormal modes, leading to higher quality factors. These spectral shifts are quantitatively explained by changes in the photon-sphere properties through the eikonal correspondence. Since the effects scale with the ratio of the halo mass to its size, they are observable only for dark matter concentrated within a few tens of gravitational radii of the black hole, which is the regime considered here.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在广义相对论框架内系统研究暗物质晕对黑洞阴影与准正规模的影响，构建单参数解族并给出解析与半解析分析，同时与EHT观测对比，理论层次和方法严谨性信号较强，主题与索引方向相关，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 视界处存在暗物质时的黑洞阴影与准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 本文研究周围暗物质晕对黑洞两个视界尺度可观测量的影响：其阴影与准正规模谱。我们考虑一个嵌入Hernquist晕的Schwarzschild黑洞，并构造一个单参数解族，该解族保持晕的总质量不变，同时改变晕密度在视界处趋于零的方式。通过用Einstein-cluster应力张量闭合Einstein方程，我们表明视界正则性要求密度至少线性地趋于零。我们的结果还表明，主能量条件在视界外一薄层中被违反，这突显了Einstein-cluster描述在光子球内的局限性。我们证明，在黑洞质量固定的情况下，晕总是使阴影增大，且对于质量更大、更致密的晕，该效应更为显著。与事件视界望远镜对Sgr\,A$^*$和M87$^*$的观测比较表明，只有足够致密的晕才能被约束，且所推断的界限敏感地依赖于所观测的质量是被认定为黑洞质量还是系统总质量。我们进一步表明，晕降低了电磁和轴向引力准正规模的振荡频率与阻尼率，从而导致更高的品质因子。这些谱移动通过eikonal对应关系由光子球性质的变化定量解释。由于这些效应随晕质量与其尺寸之比缩放，它们只有在暗物质集中在黑洞周围数十个引力半径以内时才可观测，而这正是本文所考虑的区域。
